name: PowerShell
scope: A person with INTERMEDIATE proficiency level in PowerShell as a competency should be able to design and maintain reusable PowerShell Core (pwsh) modules and automation pipelines that run reliably on Linux or Windows. They write advanced functions with CmdletBinding, pipeline input (begin/process/end), parameter sets and validation; structure code into .psm1 modules with exported functions; stream large data sets through the pipeline instead of accumulating in memory; handle DateTime parsing, culture and time zones correctly; compare semantic versions; call REST APIs with Invoke-RestMethod including pagination, retry with backoff and error classification; process CSV/JSON at scale with robust validation and quarantine flows; and make automation idempotent and side-effect-free in dry-run mode. They design for testability (injectable clocks, small pure functions) and write thorough Pester test suites including mocks, edge cases and performance assertions.
long_scope:
**Competency Scope for PowerShell - INTERMEDIATE Proficiency**

### 1. Advanced Functions and Modules
- CmdletBinding, [Parameter()] attributes, parameter sets, pipeline input with begin/process/end
- .psm1 module structure, Export-ModuleMember, module manifests
- Emitting typed PSCustomObjects; separating data from presentation
- ShouldProcess/-WhatIf support and genuinely side-effect-free dry-run modes

### 2. Data and Time Correctness
- DateTime parsing with explicit formats and cultures; UTC vs local; midnight/DST edge cases
- Injectable reference clocks for testable time logic
- Semantic version parsing and comparison
- Robust CSV/JSON processing: quoted fields, BOMs, malformed rows, reject/quarantine flows

### 3. Scale and Performance
- Streaming through the pipeline instead of loading directories/files into memory
- Group-Object/hashtable-based aggregation over large collections
- Meeting explicit time budgets on thousands of input files

### 4. REST APIs and External Systems
- Invoke-RestMethod: pagination, authentication headers, structured payloads
- Bounded retry with exponential backoff; fail-fast on 4xx vs retry on 5xx
- Building summary/report objects for downstream consumption

### 5. Reliability Engineering and Testing
- Warnings vs terminating errors; per-item failure isolation in batch jobs
- Idempotent re-runs; archive/quarantine patterns
- Pester: Describe/Context/It, Mock, BeforeAll, tag-based runs, performance assertions
